highlights_headline: Backports the Apple 26.0 unversioned TFMs and a WinUI Projection DLL fix to the v3 line.
highlights_body: This preview backports the .NET 9 WinUI packaging fix and the Apple unversioned app TFM support already shipped on v4, alongside CI stability work.

bullets.detail: Fixes a missing WinUI Projection DLL that broke .NET 9 consumers referencing SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI.

bullets.lead: Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFMs backported
bullets.detail: Brings the Apple 26.0 native library and unversioned application target framework monikers to the v3 servicing line.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported the Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM support to the v3 line.
